videos.title: [LIVE] 6.3 지방선거 첫날 사전투표율 최종 11.6%…역대 지선 최고치, 국회의원 재보선은 12.07%/2026년 5월 29일(금)/KBS
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video transcript in Korean, within approximately 500 characters, using 3-5 sentences. The content is about the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections in Korea.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Early voting began with 11.6% turnout (highest for local elections), and by-elections at 12.07%
2. Both ruling and opposition parties are focusing on mobilizing supporters
3. Democratic Party (민주당) is framing this as supporting President Lee Jae-myung and judging the previous government's incompetence
4. People Power Party (국민의힘) is criticizing high prices, taxes, and government arrogance, urging votes to stop them
5. AI analysis shows the value of one vote: in Gangwon-do, total budget managed by elected officials is 110 trillion won over 4 years, making each vote worth over 83 million won
6. Cost of elections and wasted tax money if people don't vote
